title: Microbiome Assay for DNA Extraction and Sequencing
author: Wen Aw
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.shjeb4n

steps.title: Extract Total DNA
steps.instruction: Extract total DNA from 6 sets of 4 guts of early third instar larvae.

substeps.instruction: Use the NucleoSpin® Tissue XS DNA extraction kit (Machery-Nagel, Düren, Germany) following the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Amplify 16S rRNA Gene V4 Region
steps.instruction: Amplify the V4 region of the 16S rRNA gene by PCR in duplicate for each sample.

steps.title: Pool and Sequence PCR Products
steps.instruction: Pool the duplicate PCR products and sequence them using a MiSeq platform with 2 x 250 bp chemistry.

steps.title: Process Sequences into OTUs
steps.instruction: Merge paired-end sequences into contigs and cluster into Operational Taxonomic Units (OTUs) at 97% sequence similarity using Mothur and its standard operating procedure for MiSeq data.

substeps.instruction: Remove singleton contigs after the pre-clustering step.

steps.title: Taxonomically Classify OTUs
steps.instruction: Taxonomically classify OTUs using the Ribosomal Database Project taxonomy with a 60% confidence threshold.

substeps.instruction: Compare communities at a genus level.

steps.title: Rarefy and Normalize Samples
steps.instruction: Rarefy each sample to the same total number of sequences (n=41,859) to account for different sequencing depth.

substeps.instruction: Convert to relative abundance for analysis.
